definitions: Geometries are exact rail, ramp and support layouts modulo translation, excluding signals and circuit/power entities; not abstract graph isomorphism classes.
Configurations include signals; labels and entity numbering do not count as changes.
Only native exit_code0 with final result is a completed experiment.
Unchanged IDs with changed bytes are reported and cannot silently inherit previous test evidence.
No mixed-bank, mixed-window or mixed-scenario aggregate should be ranked.
note: Construction/graph/clock/CPU gates are separate. Full raw cases are in the private research archive.
